note: Normative policy examples, not a live model benchmark or automatic routing classifier. Ordinary means medium only when independent review is warranted.

cases.assignment: Multi-file feature needs local design decisions; objective, paths and acceptance are clear; no identical prior pattern.
Implement an approved wire-format extension with specified compatibility; a material compatibility risk has been identified.
Add the agreed permission helper to a mutation path; existing policy is explicit; material authorization risk is named.
A newly written focused test fails and exposes a straightforward implementation error.
An unfamiliar package needs a bounded feature and tests, with no unresolved architecture approval.
Implement an approved lifetime/ownership protocol; subtle regressions warrant named independent review.
Evidence from a bounded investigation contradicts the documented cross-thread teardown invariant.
cases.deep_reason: Resolve the conflicting teardown and ownership invariants using the captured failing sequence.

cases.assignment: Before dispatch, integrator identifies a difficult non-local causal bug with competing explanations within approved scope.
cases.deep_reason: Discriminate the competing causes with a minimal reproduction; reuse prior observations.

cases.assignment: Completion would require a material unapproved architecture or ownership expansion.
Run the already selected build/test commands and collect outcomes without source edits.
Primary already owns and understands a small tightly coupled implementation.
The selected model is unavailable because its allowance is exhausted; no alternative has approval.
Normal review reports no blocking findings and no independent material risk has been identified.
